sloka: तमापतन्तं ज्वलितं खरपुत्रकराच्च्युतम्।बाणैस्तु त्रिभिराकाशे शूलं चिच्छेद राघवः ।। ६.७९.३३ ।।
transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ jvalitaṁ kharaputrakarāccyutam।bāṇaistu tribhirākāśe śūlaṁ ciccheda rāghavaḥ ।। 6.79.33 ।।

translations.english: The night ranger whirling round and round the glowing pike furiously hurled at Raghava in that conflict.
